'''Kaink''' was an oracle in the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology. "Kaink" was a popular name for female [[Wokling/Legends|Ewok children]],<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Kaink/Legends|a priestess]] who was the [[Bright Tree Village]]'s [[legend keeper]].<ref name="Wagon">{{Ewoks|Wicket's Wagon}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kaink was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
